title: Okhay Safar Nay Maawaan
body:
Okhay safar nay maawaa’n day baaj ridawaa’n day.
<<DIVIDER>>
Assi Ghazi haye teray bajo rulliyan wich sehrawaa’n day, baaj ridawaa’n day..
<<DIVIDER>>
Alma walay bhira koi tarteeb bana sanu mil jaye rida
Loka toun haye nahin chupday neel aay sadiyan bahnwaa’n day. Baaj ridawaa’n day..
<<DIVIDER>>
Teer huraml day sahay tu tay Asghar nay jeewain veer karbal andar
Safraan wich haye assi jhalday rehnay teer nighawaa’n day baaj ridawaa’n day..
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhanwain saanga uttay band akhiyan kitay veer nay nal meray
Keewain langiye haye das Ghazi galliyan naal bhirawaan day baaj ridawaa’n day..
<<DIVIDER>>
Jeewain Saqlain raye wich karbal laashay bay kafan putraan day
Unj qaidi haye rasiyan wich reh gaye laashay maawaa’n day baaj ridawaa’n day..
